about.highlight: Senior Frontend Developer (Angular) building freight forwarding software in Hamburg. At Colleto I was the first frontend developer: I built three Angular applications from scratch, moved them into an NX monorepo with 15 domain libraries and more than 700 components, and now review every frontend merge request and mentor the developers who contribute to the frontend. We work in Angular 20 with standalone components, signals and RxJS. Before software, I spent 8 years as a civil engineer and was Head of Structural Department, with 13 engineers reporting to me.

journey.title: On a journey to new frontiers
journey.p1: Throughout my 8-year career as a civil engineer, I was fascinated by how digitalization and web applications changed the core work in my field and everything around it.
journey.p2: To make my team's work more effective, I looked for ways to get the most out of every application we used, exploring different scripts and APIs.
journey.p3: Over time my curiosity grew, and so did my wish to build applications of my own for the parts of my work and everyday life that digital tools could improve.
journey.p4: In 2018 I committed to that fully: I enrolled in the JavaScript Web Developer program at SoftUni, built my first web application from the ground up, and later joined an agile start-up team of developers who share my curiosity.
journey.p5: Today I own the frontend of three Angular applications and want to keep growing toward technical leadership, while building software that makes people's work easier.

colleto.highlights: Architected and built three Angular applications from scratch for the freight forwarding operations of our parent company. When the second app was needed, I moved the codebase into an NX monorepo, which now holds 15 domain libraries and more than 700 components. The apps use Angular 20 with standalone components, signals and RxJS, and talk to the backend through a GitLab-hosted, auto-generated REST API client. They are used by 400–500 employees in daily freight management and replaced paper-based steps in the forwarding process.

tms.info:
Colleta TMS is a dispatching tool for transport management. It is the fallback platform where dispatchers manually bundle shipments that the AI could not dispatch automatically.

Colleta TMS turns bundling several shipments, creating a tour request and contacting numerous carriers into a few clicks. Price negotiation and the assignment of the transport order also happen on this platform.

carrypicker.highlights: Developed features for three web applications: Carrypicker, Colleta TMS and Colleta Trucking. Together they cover the whole truck transport process: a shipment order is placed in Carrypicker, dispatched automatically by AI (with manual dispatching in Colleta TMS as the fallback), and turned into tour requests and transport orders on the Colleta Trucking platform. The Colleta User Management platform connects the three.

info.1: ▪︎   Shipper Platform - a web platform, where shippers can easily input shipping orders. It provides AI-based day price calculation algorithm and supports manual, CSV or excel based shipment input. The web portal keeps track of the status and the position of the shipments relevant to a single user or to a group of users. It also issues automatically shipping orders and allows for document exchange between stakeholders.
info.2: ▪︎   Dispatcher Platform - a web disposition tool that serves mainly transport management purposes. It is meant as a fallback web platform, where shipments that could not be disposed automatically by the AI, are bundled manually by dispatchers. Colleta TMS reduces the process chain of bundling multiple shipments together, creating a tour request and contacting numerous carriers to a couple of button clicks. The price negotiation and the actual assignment of a transport order also take place in this web platform.
info.3: ▪︎   Trucking Platform - a web application meant for transportation carriers. It allows them to actively participate in tour request bids, register available transportation vehicles and commonly run routes. Another feature of the platform is keeping history of all transportation assignments and providing online-access the respective documentation.
info.4: ▪︎   User Management - provides user management for the other three web platforms: Carrypicker, Colleta and Colleta Trucking. It allows for intersystem data exchange and is the place where the onboarding for all stakeholders in the Carrypicker ecosystem takes place.

recipes.highlights: Cooking Recipes is a lightweight single-page application for discovering, creating, and sharing cooking recipes. The application follows a domain-driven frontend architecture, ensuring clear separation of concerns, scalability, and maintainability. A reactive typeahead search provides fast and intuitive navigation across content.
info: ▪   Angular 20 SPA with a domain-driven frontend structure

▪   Reactive typeahead search implemented across all list views for fast and precise results
▪   Frontend and backend validation in detail views to enhance user experience and application security
▪   NestJS backend with a clean, scalable REST architecture
▪   JWT-based authentication using HttpOnly cookies for enhanced security

Whether errands, repairs, design work, or freelance tasks, this app makes it easy to share your job offer and find skilled, reliable workers nearby.
